lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of low-to-mid luminance circular clusters arranged in four to five identifiable horizontal rows along the visible mid-section; highest intensity maxima are clustered in the posterior-superior quadrant of the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal ridges present on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp luminance transition from light on the dorsal aspect to shadow on the ventral aspect.
